NASA to Launch Mission to Rescue Falling Space Telescope

The US space agency NASA plans to launch a robotic spacecraft to rescue the Neil Gehrels Swift Observatory, which is expected to fall from orbit in the coming days. The telescope was launched in 2004 and has been providing valuable data on gamma-ray bursts and other astrophysical phenomena. The mission aims to boost the telescope back into higher orbit using the robotic spacecraft.
